property_summary: For every caller address, only the owner can successfully self-destruct the contract (call sudicideAnyone) — the mutant inverts the require so some non-owner can self-destruct, violating this invariant for some caller addresses.
change_summary: Invert the require condition so only non-owners can call sudicideAnyone, allowing non-owner callers to selfdestruct the contract while blocking the owner.
